feedback_text: I started a claim but stopped at the paperwork step because I could not work out which forms applied to my case.
My claim says one document is missing without naming it. I cannot complete the request until I know what to provide.
It would help to see the required paperwork before starting the claim instead of discovering each item one screen at a time.
I called only to ask which receipt format is accepted. The requirement itself should be clearer online.
The same medical report has been requested again. It is already listed in my submitted files.
Please add a visible timestamp beside each uploaded document so I can confirm what was sent and when.
I want to submit receipts for several appointments together rather than open a separate claim for each one.
I received a partial reimbursement but cannot see how the amount was calculated.
I am disappointed by the amount, but the calculation is clearly explained and there is no processing problem.
The password rules appear only after submission. Please show them while I am creating the password.
It is annoying to sign in again, but I was able to continue immediately and nothing was lost.
I can access the website with my details, but the mobile app says the account does not exist.
My connection dropped on the final step. When I reopened the app, the draft and attachments were still there.
The instructions are clear overall, but the difference between service date and invoice date could be explained better.
The claim was resolved quickly, but the status notification arrived a day after I saw the change in the app.
